summary: Get one dashboard by UUID: hosted Streamlit metadata + connection bindings, or leftover legacy cards. Ownership-gated.

params.name: dashboard_id
params.doc: UUID from dashboard_read('list') or deploy_dashboard / update_dashboard response. Must be a valid UUID string.

returns: { dashboard: {id, title, description, insights, owner_email, owner_name, share_slug, is_public, live_url, share_url, shared_at, card_count, created_at, updated_at, cards:[{id, key, title, platform, tool_name, chart_type, chart_config, query_params, position, refreshed_at, created_at}]} } | {error, message} | {error, error_type:'unauthenticated', message}

summary: List hosted Streamlit dashboards (and leftover legacy card rows) for the current user, scoped to the active project. Returns title, kind, host_status, bindings, live_url, id.
returns: { dashboards: [{id, title, description, insights, owner_email, owner_name, share_slug, is_public, live_url, share_url, shared_at, card_count, created_at, updated_at}], total, create_hint, manage_url, sharing_hint } | {error, error_type:'unauthenticated', message}
